items.title: Eddie Summers Interview, 1963-11-11
items.q: I played with Howard, Sheik, and uh, Toker. ... Well, Lawrence Toker was in the same band. You, and George Augustin. All together, yes.

ctx.x: I played with Howard, Sheik, and uh, Toker. I was Toker.
They didn't wear any kind of uniforms like Sheik, huh? They did, they did. That's a funny story. We used to go... It's worth getting that type of hands of Buddy Toker.
